SELECT
  SUM(r.sr_return_amt) AS return_amt_sum,
  SUM(s.ss_net_paid)  AS net_paid_sum,
  ROUND(SUM(r.sr_return_amt) / SUM(s.ss_net_paid) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct,
  COUNT(*) AS sales_rows_in_period,
  COUNT(r.sr_return_amt) AS matched_return_rows
FROM store_sales s
JOIN date_dim d ON s.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns r
  ON r.sr_ticket_number = s.ss_ticket_number
 AND r.sr_item_sk = s.ss_item_sk
WHERE d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy = 9;
